I see. The loader reads the 2-byte size, then when it reaches `EL_EXIF_FOUND`, it copies from `eld->b + i` where `i` is the index in the small buffer. The size is the total EXIF data size. The `exif_loader_copy` copies `eld->size` bytes into `eld->buf`. 

The key question is: does `eld->buf` include the 2-byte size prefix? Looking at the flow: when `EL_EXIF_FOUND` is reached, `i` points to the byte after the size bytes. So `eld->b + i` points to the "Exif\0\0" header. So `eld->buf` contains the EXIF data starting from "Exif\0\0" (without the 2-byte size prefix).

So the file format for the loader is: `[2-byte size][Exif\0\0][II][0x2a][IFD0 offset]...`. The size should be the total length of the EXIF data (from "Exif\0\0" onwards).
